title: Rosemary Beach "Never Say Never" 113 Bourne Lane
h1: Rosemary Beach "Never Say Never" 113 Bourne Lane
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach- Walking distance to Barrett Square- Convenient location- Professionally decorated- 2 vehicle parking- 4 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Never Say Never is a 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom Rosemary Beach home that sleeps 10 in comfortable luxury. The house is a short walk to the beach, has a lovely elevated deck, and guests will enjoy peaceful park views from an upstairs balcony. An open-concept living, dining, and kitchen area encompass the first floor. Rich cherry molding surrounds floor-to-ceiling windows and French doors that flood the space with natural light and wooded views. The spacious kitchen has stainless steel appliances and a raised island that seats 3. A long dining table next to the kitchen seats 6. A wrap-around sofa and armchair in the living area are joined by a smaller dining table that seats 4. A double pair of French doors open to an elevated outdoor deck with lounge chairs, an outdoor shower with privacy doors, and a small table to enjoy lunch or a game of cards. A primary bedroom and 2 guest bedrooms are on the second floor. A guest bedroom with a queen bed shares a bathroom with a shower/tub combo with a second guest bedroom. This second guest bedroom has a king bed and a door that opens to a large wrap-around balcony with lovely views of Triangle Park. Down the hall is a writing desk and a primary bedroom with a king bed, a private bathroom with a shower, and French doors that open to the balcony. A small table with chairs on the balcony creates a beautiful space to sit, enjoy morning coffee or tea, and listen to birdsong from the park.A spiral staircase leads to a third-floor loft with a cozy living room with a wrap-around sofa, flat-screen TV, and a separate bedroom with 2 twin beds with trundles and a private bathroom with a shower. Rosemary Beach and nearby Seacrest and Alys Beach are easy to explore, thanks to 4 included adult bikes! With its fabulous location and peaceful views, Bourne Cottage will book quickly. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):FIRST FLOOR:- Guest Bathroom: Shower OnlySECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Guest Bedroom: King Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR LOFT:- Guest Bedroom: Two Twin Beds with Trundles, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyIn addition, you also have access to these fantastic Rosemary Beach amenities:- Coquina Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.- Sky Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 6 am to 10 pm (Adult Only Hours, 6 am-9 am & 8 pm-10 pm)- Cabana Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.- Barbados Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property, forfeit any rental payments, and be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
